cards: Andy must hold bread and a cookie. Bread uses 3 wheat at a crafting table. Cookies use 2 wheat and 1 cocoa bean at a crafting table. Andy must also hold a hay bale (hay_block), made with 9 wheat in a crafting table. Andy must also hold packed_mud, which you make as follows: packed mud uses 1 mud and 1 wheat.

Jill must hold paper and a golden apple. Paper uses 3 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold sugar, made from 1 sugar cane. Jill must also hold bone_meal, crafted from 1 bone.

Andy must hold bread and a pumpkin pie. Bread uses 3 wheat at a crafting table. A pumpkin pie uses pumpkin, egg, and sugar, one of each. Andy must also hold a hay bale (hay_block), made with 9 wheat in a crafting table. Andy must also hold melon_seeds, which you make as follows: melon seeds use 1 melon slice.

Jill must hold sugar and a golden apple. Sugar uses 1 sugar cane. A golden apple uses 1 apple and 8 gold ingots at a crafting table. Jill must also hold paper, made from 3 sugar cane. Jill must also hold bone_meal, crafted from 1 bone.

Andy must hold orange dye and pink dye. Orange dye uses red dye and yellow dye. Pink dye uses red dye and white dye. The exact item names are orange_dye and pink_dye. Andy must also hold purple dye, made from red and blue dye. Andy must also hold lime_dye, which you make as follows: lime dye uses 1 green dye and 1 white dye.
